page.overview:
Who is Medanor Eramandos?

Her name could indicate that she was from Illian, given her melodious surname that ends with -os.

Medanor held the position for twenty-nine years until her death in . She was Balladare Arandaille's successor and Kiyosa Natomo's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

It is possible that the Kavarthen Wars continued into her reign, as they are only stated as having begun at the end of the reign of the former Amyrlin Seat.

She was a fairly strong Amyrlin and skilled in mediation.
